docs.text: This beach spider has excellent camouflage on the sandy shore of Lake Huron, Ontario
Woot woot new Lake Michigan! Live!‬ spider just dropped.
This is either a scene from The Birds, or yet another Great Lakes cam has been colonized by spiders.
In spring, let's launch the Northeast & Great Lakes Regional Spider League 😂 (Only cause I rarely find them inside weirdly)
Fort Erie, Buffalo, Erie PA has the most biggest spiders I've ever seen. The lake insects emerging have evolved them to live at this end of Lake Erie. Its creepy. Search it. 🤬

I mean, go to literally any marina on Lake Erie and you will see 10,000 spiders immediately come to say hi (this was a constant thing on my wife's family's old boat, we had to toss tons of them off the decks).

Massive is a little overkill.
I have one on my deck right now ( it's gorgeous, btw ), and while it's bigger than the other spiders out there, I wouldn't say it's massive compared to the ones I had when I lived on Lake Erie.
The spider guy who sprayed my porch asked to keep one of those 😅
I live about 100m from lake Erie. There are tonnes of spiders and I've become friends with them; cute lil' guys :^)
!! Including an explanation of the Cleveland Spiders name—were they named for all of the many & giant spiders that live in ships' rigging (seriously) in Lake Erie?
Spider found at Queen's Keep and sunset from the beach at Lake Superior
Our family vacationed along Lake Erie last week. If anyone starts to be verbally belligerent about Spider-Man, I'll let you know.
I must say I've nvr heard of spider season but we rented an Airbnb on lake Ontario...I've nvr seen so many big spiders and so freakin active in the evening!
